lines.text: Many learners say: I was late on the lesson.
Better: I was late for the lesson.
For! We are late for the bus.

data.wrong: I was late on the lesson.
data.right: I was late for the lesson.

native.tip: После late нужно “for”: “I was late for the lesson.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I was late on the lesson”? 😅 Русское «опоздал на урок» тянет за собой “on”, а нужно “for.” Правильно: “I was late for the lesson.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “for.” После late — for. Напиши своё предложение с “I was late for.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: After late, use “for”: “I was late for the lesson.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I was late on the lesson”? 😅 Russian “late on the lesson” pulls you toward “on,” but English needs “for.” Correct: “I was late for the lesson.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
